segments.an6.10:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
segments.an6.10:1.2: Atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno, kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an6.10:1.3: “yo so, bhante, ariyasāvako āgataphalo viññātasāsano, so katamena vihārena bahulaṃ viharatī”ti?
segments.an6.10:2.1: “Yo so, mahānāma, ariyasāvako āgataphalo viññātasāsano, so iminā vihārena bahulaṃ viharati.[a. ni.11.11] Idha, mahānāma, ariyasāvako tathāgataṃ anussarati –
segments.an6.10:2.3: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti.
segments.an6.10:2.4: Yasmiṃ, mahānāma, samaye ariyasāvako tathāgataṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti;
segments.an6.10:2.5: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti tathāgataṃ ārabbha.
segments.an6.10:2.6: Ujugatacitto kho pana, mahānāma, ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.
segments.an6.10:2.7: Pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
segments.an6.10:2.9: ‘ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno buddhānussatiṃ bhāveti’”.
segments.an6.10:3.2: ‘svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī’ti.
segments.an6.10:3.3: Yasmiṃ, mahānāma, samaye ariyasāvako dhammaṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti;
segments.an6.10:3.4: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti dhammaṃ ārabbha.
segments.an6.10:3.5: Ujugatacitto kho pana, mahānāma, ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhita pāmojjaṃ.
segments.an6.10:3.6: Pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
segments.an6.10:3.8: ‘ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno dhammānussatiṃ bhāveti’”.
segments.an6.10:4.2: ‘suppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ujuppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ñāyappaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, sāmīcippaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, yadidaṃ cattāri purisayugāni aṭṭha purisapuggalā esa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā’ti.
segments.an6.10:4.3: Yasmiṃ, mahānāma, samaye ariyasāvako saṅghaṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti;
segments.an6.10:4.4: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti saṅghaṃ ārabbha.
segments.an6.10:4.5: Ujugatacitto kho pana, mahānāma, ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.
segments.an6.10:4.6: Pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
segments.an6.10:4.8: ‘ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno saṅghānussatiṃ bhāveti’”.
segments.an6.10:5.1: “Puna caparaṃ, mahānāma, ariyasāvako attano sīlāni anussarati akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññuppasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikāni.
segments.an6.10:5.2: Yasmiṃ, mahānāma, samaye ariyasāvako sīlaṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti;
segments.an6.10:5.3: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti sīlaṃ ārabbha.
segments.an6.10:5.4: Ujugatacitto kho pana, mahānāma, ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.
segments.an6.10:5.5: Pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
segments.an6.10:5.7: ‘ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno sīlānussatiṃ bhāveti’”.
segments.an6.10:6.1: “Puna caparaṃ, mahānāma, ariyasāvako attano cāgaṃ anussarati –
segments.an6.10:6.3: Yohaṃ maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitāya pajāya vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasāmi muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato’ti.
segments.an6.10:6.4: Yasmiṃ, mahānāma, samaye ariyasāvako cāgaṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti;
segments.an6.10:6.5: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti cāgaṃ ārabbha.
segments.an6.10:6.6: Ujugatacitto kho pana, mahānāma, ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.
segments.an6.10:6.7: Pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
segments.an6.10:6.9: ‘ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno cāgānussatiṃ bhāveti’”.
segments.an6.10:7.2: ‘santi devā cātumahārājikā [cātummahārājikā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)], santi devā tāvatiṃsā, santi devā yāmā, santi devā tusitā, santi devā nimmānaratino, santi devā paranimmitavasavattino, santi devā brahmakāyikā, santi devā tatuttari [tatuttariṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.), taduttari (ka.) a. ni.6.25; visuddhi.1.162 passitabbaṃ].
segments.an6.10:7.3: Yathārūpāya saddhāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā [tattha uppannā (sī.), tatthūpapannā (syā. kaṃ.), tatthupapannā (a. ni.3.71)], mayhampi tathārūpā saddhā saṃvijjati.
segments.an6.10:7.4: Yathārūpena sīlena samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayhampi tathārūpaṃ sīlaṃ saṃvijjati.
segments.an6.10:7.5: Yathārūpena sutena samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayhampi tathārūpaṃ sutaṃ saṃvijjati.
segments.an6.10:7.6: Yathārūpena cāgena samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayhampi tathārūpo cāgo saṃvijjati.
segments.an6.10:7.7: Yathārūpāya paññāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayhampi tathārūpā paññā saṃvijjatī’ti.
segments.an6.10:7.8: Yasmiṃ, mahānāma, samaye ariyasāvako attano ca tāsañca devatānaṃ saddhañca sīlañca sutañca cāgañca paññañca anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti;
segments.an6.10:7.9: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti tā devatā ārabbha.
segments.an6.10:7.10: Ujugatacitto kho pana, mahānāma, ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.
segments.an6.10:7.11: Pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
segments.an6.10:7.13: ‘ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya [sabyāpajjhāya … abyāpajjho (ka.)] pajāya abyāpajjo [sabyāpajjhāya … abyāpajjho (ka.)] viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno devatānussatiṃ bhāveti’”.
segments.an6.10:8.1: “Yo so, mahānāma, ariyasāvako āgataphalo viññātasāsano, so iminā vihārena bahulaṃ viharatī”ti.
segments.an6.10:9.1: Dve āhuneyyā indriya, balāni tayo ājānīyā;

lines: Dasame mahānāmoti dasabalassa cūḷapitu putto eko sakyarājā.
Yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamīti bhuttapātarāso hutvā dāsaparijanaparivuto gandhamālādīni gāhāpetvā yattha satthā, tattha agamāsi.
Iti ayaṃ rājā “sotāpannassa nissayavihāraṃ pucchāmī”ti pucchanto evamāha.
Nevassa rāgapariyuṭṭhitanti na uppajjamānena rāgena uṭṭhahitvā gahitaṃ.
Kāyo passambhatīti nāmakāyo ca karajakāyo ca darathapaṭippassaddhiyā paṭippassambhati.
Pariyuṭṭhānappattipi, rāgena vā saṃhitaṃ cittaṃ araññamiva corehi tena pariyuṭṭhitanti vuttaṃ, tassa pariyuṭṭhānaṭṭhānabhāvatopi pariyuṭṭhitarāganti attho.
Byañjanaṃ pana anādiyitvā atthamattaṃ dassento “uppajjamānena rāgena uṭṭhahitvā gahitan”ti āha.
Ujukamevāti pageva kāyavaṅkādīnaṃ apanītattā cittassa ca anujubhāvakarānaṃ mānādīnaṃ abhāvato, rāgādipariyuṭṭhānābhāvena vā oṇatiuṇṇativirahato ujubhāvameva gataṃ.
Atha vā ujukamevāti kammaṭṭhānassa thinaṃ middhaṃ otiṇṇatāya līnuddhaccavigamato majjhimasamathanimittappaṭipattiyā ujubhāvameva gataṃ.
“Ārakattā arahan”ti anussarantassa hi yadidaṃ bhagavato kilesehi ārakattaṃ, so hetu.
Ñāpako cettha hetu adhippeto, na kārako sampāpako.
Iminā nayena sesapadesupi hetuso phalavipāko veditabbo.
Dhammānussati ādīsupi hi ādimajjhapariyosānakalyāṇatādayo suppaṭipattiādayo ca tattha tattha hetubhāvena niddiṭṭhāyeva.
